plan.title: Create Single-Stage RFQ from Service PR

steps.note: Provide the mandatory event title before publication.
Assert that the RFQ template was applied.
Verify that the RFQ pricing sheet rendered the expected PR and pricing columns.
Assert that PR-derived product, variant, and quantity fields are locked while pricing and delivery location remain editable.
Verify that the PR quantity is displayed in the created event.
Verify that the PR unit is displayed in the created event.
Commit the default Start now and 30-minute event schedule.
Add the two vendors named by the test case.
Assert that publication reached a real project page.
Confirm that publication did not produce an application error.
Verify the PR-created event cannot use Recreate Order and that the menu item is greyed out.
